AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Nurturing minds, shaping futures, and building tomorrow's leaders through academic excellence and holistic education.
AboutPage.missionSubtitle: Guided by purpose, driven by passion for educational excellence.
AboutPage.missionText: To provide a transformative educational experience that develops intellectually curious, morally upright, and socially responsible individuals who are prepared to lead and serve in an ever-changing world.
AboutPage.visionText: To be the foremost institution of academic excellence in Bangladesh, recognized for producing graduates who contribute meaningfully to society through knowledge, integrity, and leadership.
AboutPage.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide everything we do.
AboutPage.value1Desc: Setting the highest standards in education and continuously pushing the boundaries of what students can achieve.
AboutPage.value2Desc: Building a foundation of honesty, transparency, and moral responsibility in every student and educator.
AboutPage.value3Desc: Welcoming every student regardless of background, fostering a culture of respect, belonging, and mutual support.
AboutPage.value4Desc: Embracing modern pedagogy, technology, and creative thinking to prepare students for the challenges of tomorrow.
AboutPage.value5Desc: Cultivating the next generation of leaders through co-curricular activities, mentorship, and real-world challenges.
AboutPage.value6Desc: Encouraging students to give back to their communities and develop a sense of civic responsibility.
AboutPage.historySubtitle: A legacy of excellence spanning over five decades.
AboutPage.history1Desc: Dhanbari Collegiate Model School was established with a vision to provide quality education to the students of Dhanbari and surrounding areas.
AboutPage.history2Desc: The school expanded its facilities with new science laboratories, a library, and sports grounds to support a growing student population.
AboutPage.history3Desc: Received national recognition for outstanding academic performance and was awarded the status of a Model School by the Ministry of Education.
AboutPage.history4Desc: Launched a comprehensive digital transformation, introducing ICT labs, smart classrooms, and an online student management system.
AboutPage.history5Desc: Celebrating over 50 years of academic excellence with record-breaking pass rates and expanding our programs to meet modern educational needs.
AboutPage.facilitiesSubtitle: Modern infrastructure designed to inspire and support every student's journey.
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of students who have chosen DCMS as their home for academic growth and personal development.
